papers.title: Large Language Model-Empowered Co-Evolutionary Model Merging for Neural Vehicle Routing Solvers
papers.verification_status: local original manuscript and technical supplement available; publication identity unverified
papers.abstract: CEMM co-evolves LLM-generated merging programs and a dual-role population of a generalist and task-aligned experts for neural vehicle routing solvers. Evaluated on five VRP variants and two backbones.
papers.source_excerpt: For algorithm evolution, CEMM uses LLMs to generate merging programs tailored to evolving NCO models and selects them according to their task-wise marginal contributions.
